author: Sega Jenesis
title: Commission artist for custom Pokémon card binder scenes
content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀 I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Obviously, this is a PAID commission! Contact: reply with portfolios, pricing, and availability or DM.
